CSE-4014                                                                                                                about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 27-Nov-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VII Semester - End Semester Examination - Nov/ Dec -2024  
  Applications of AI in Medicine [CSE-4014]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)              Discuss the concept of the margin in Support Vector Machines and explain how it is  
  maximized in the training process.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Discuss the steps to be performed in K means clustering.                               (5)  
  2)              Demonstrate the synthetic skin lesions with its attributes and values.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Demonstrate the steps involved in minimization of error by backpropagation algorithm. (5)  
  
  3)              Discuss the following multiclass methods:  
  (i) OvsO  
  (5)  
  (ii) ECOC  
  A)  
  B)         Explain the working process of electroencephalogram.                                   (5)  
  4)              Discuss the following liquid base cytology technologies:  
  (i) SurePath  
  (5)  
  (ii) ThinPrep  
  A)  
  B)         Discuss the deep belief networks with a neat diagram.                                  (5)  
  5)              With a neat diagram, discuss the text rank algorithm.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Design the diagnostic decision tree for the symptom "face pain".                       (5)  
  
  -----End-----
